description: 2022-2024. A pattern emerges across Pakistan's major cities: India's most-wanted terrorists are dying. March 2022: Zahoor Mistry (IC-814 hijacker, the man who inspired Film 1) shot dead at his Crescent Furniture store in Karachi — 22 years after the hijacking. 2023: Sajid Mir (26/11 handler, the ghost who was declared dead by Pakistan) reportedly poisoned in custody. May 2023: Paramjit Singh Panjwar (Khalistan Commando Force chief, Pakistan-based) shot dead in Lahore. 2023-2024: Multiple Hizbul and JeM commanders die in car bombs, shootings, 'unknown assailants'. The Guardian reports 'up to 20 assassinations since 2020, Indian government ordered.' Pakistan's intelligence officials brief The Guardian; Islamabad lodges formal diplomatic protests. Hamza — Jaskirat Singh Rangi, living under a third cover identity, operational in Karachi — is the covert instrument. The turning point: Pakistan's ISI has identified the pattern and has a partial profile of the operator. Does Hamza complete the final target on his list — or break contact and exfiltrate before ISI closes the net?

real_world_correlation.real_event: Series of killings in Pakistan: (1) March 2022 — Zahoor Mistry (Abdul Latif Mistry), IC-814 hijacker, shot dead at Karachi furniture shop; (2) 2023 — Sajid Mir reportedly poisoned in Pakistani custody after FATF-pressured conviction; (3) May 2023 — Paramjit Singh Panjwar (KCF chief) shot in Lahore; (4) 2023-2024 — multiple Hizbul Mujahideen and JeM commanders killed by unknown assailants in PoK and Pakistan. The Guardian (April 2024) reported Indian government allegedly behind 'up to 20 assassinations since 2020', citing Pakistani intelligence officials.
real_world_correlation.attribution_pattern: All killings share characteristics: close-range gunfire, multiple assailants, no group claims responsibility, victims are Indian-designated terrorists. Methods vary: Mistry — handgun, close range; Panjwar — gunmen; Sajid Mir — disputed (prison, possibly natural causes + poison). The variation in method suggests a professional covert programme, not spontaneous local violence.
real_world_correlation.india_official_denial: India has never confirmed any involvement. Foreign Ministry responses to journalist questions: 'We don't comment on intelligence matters.' The pattern of denial mirrors Mossad's post-1972 München operation approach — acknowledged only decades later.
real_world_correlation.guardian_report_context: The April 2024 Guardian report followed Canada's September 2023 accusation (Nijjar killing) — placing India in the unprecedented position of being accused of state-sponsored assassinations in both a Five Eyes country and an adversary state simultaneously. The timing was geopolitically significant.
real_world_correlation.operational_significance: The killings close the loop on unresolved justice from Films 1 and 2: Zahoor Mistry (IC-814, Film 1) and the ISI network (Film 2) are systematically being dismantled. Each killing is a closure beat — but also an escalation in operational exposure as the pattern becomes identifiable.
real_world_correlation.isi_response: ISI identified the pattern by mid-2023. Security was significantly tightened around remaining India-designated terrorists in Pakistan. The ISI launched an internal investigation — one of the reasons Sajid Mir was 'produced alive' for FATF (May 2023) was to deny India a clean kill and demonstrate he was alive and under ISI protection.

mission_tasks.name: Assess how accurate ISI's partial profile of the operator is — does ISI have Hamza's current identity or only the pattern
Assess final target's security posture post-pattern-identification — ISI tightening protection, location known
Prepare exfiltration route — Iran land corridor via Balochistan, priority is speed over target completion
Execute final elimination — highest risk, requires abandoning all cover immediately after

adversaries.objective: Identify and capture the Indian covert operator behind the assassination pattern; end the programme; extract operational details for propaganda and diplomatic leverage; demonstrate ISI capability to protect designated terrorists

intelligence_targets.name: How complete is ISI's partial profile of the operator — current cover identity, location, cell structure
Current location and security posture of the final target — ISI protection tightened post-pattern-identification
